what: Build 4 was signed and green but stopped at botpush with stuck:push_failed. The leak check flagged 19 machine_path hits, all short test homes under /tmp named fh.<random> in exam files, plus one README path with a <uid> placeholder. None named a person or a machine.
cause: leakgrep.sh's machine_path rule flagged every path under /tmp, while AGENTS.md asks test homes to use short paths there because of the 103-byte socket limit.
fix: Decision 0011 (PR 622) and PR 625: a plain path under /tmp passes; one whose first part ends in a dash and a number is still flagged, as are home and per-user temp folders.
test: leakgrep.test.ts: a vector for a short test home and pinned laws for the four kept shapes; dropping the dash-number branch fails three laws.
